description: This file contains the implementation of node lowering functions for Torch's lazy tensor backend, including functions to lower built-in operations, node-specific lowering logic, and helper functions related to tensor operations and node transformations in the context of TorchScript and lazy evaluation.

classes.name: TsNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the lazy tensor computation graph, with functionality to lower the node into executable form.

classes.name: Cast
classes.description: Represents a type cast operation node with a method to lower itself into the graph.

classes.name: DeviceData
classes.description: Represents a node handling device-specific data, with lowering functionality.

classes.name: Expand
classes.description: Represents tensor expansion operation node, with a lower method.

classes.name: Scalar
classes.description: Represents a scalar value node with a lowering method.

methods.description: Lowers a built-in TorchScript operation into a lazy tensor operation.

methods.name: Cast::Lower
methods.description: Lowers a cast operation node into the lazy graph.

methods.name: DeviceData::Lower
methods.description: Lowers a device data node, typically fetching parameter info for the node.

methods.name: Expand::Lower
methods.description: Lowers an expand node, potentially cloning for scalar expands.

methods.name: Scalar::Lower
methods.description: Creates a constant tensor node representing a scalar value.
